description: Hidden-workspace memory slope, Chromium arm: phys_footprint (not RSS) of the app, its daemons, terminal hosts and holders and its Chromium helpers at 10 and then 60 hidden terminal+Chromium workspaces (one local site each), sampled 3 times per count after the page hibernation grace (browser.hibernation set to 1 minute in the bench config, plus the planner's normal pace); memory.hidden_slope is (F60 - F10) / 50 bytes per hidden workspace, one per sample pair.
